# Grab GitHub

Grab GitHub is a web application that allows users to download specific files and folders from any GitHub repository without needing to clone the entire repository or use the command line.

## Features
- Paste any GitHub repository, folder, or file URL.
- Browse the repository structure in a clean UI.
- Select specific files or folders to download.
- Download the selected items instantly as a ZIP file.

## Use Case
Ideal for developers who need specific scripts, templates, or components from a larger repository but don't want to clone the whole thing.
